Game Overview

Jelly Battle is a fun title where guide your adorable jelly through lively adventures in Jelly Battle. Engage in strategic skirmishes on a hexagonal battlefield, balancing play and care to keep your jelly happy. Navigate with simple mouse controls, feed, pet, wash, and unlock new skins in this captivating blend of sim and puzzle gameplay.
